The company outlines strategic expansion plans to bolster its growth.

news.title:
SMC Global Q4 FY26 revenue rose 22.6% YoY to ₹516.9 Cr; PAT surged 424.4% YoY to ₹21.5 Cr.
FY26 revenue grew 5.7% YoY, but PAT fell 29.7% YoY; insurance broking grew while derivatives hit profitability.

SMC Global Q4 FY26 revenue rose 22.6% YoY to ₹516.9 Cr; PAT surged 424.4% YoY to ₹21.5 Cr.
